scope: same-equation 600 m moving-child versus oversized stationary Nimbus reference with inherited v9 thresholds, geometry, aperture, containment movement, orthogonal reserve, receding trusted-face state, and a no-mutation parent-cell quantized trusted-balance state

quantized_trusted_balance_amendment.eligibility: a single approaching inner-margin face and its opposite remain outside the immutable relaxation zone and no bounded whole-parent-cell translation in the approaching direction strictly improves the axis minimum clearance

limitations: All numerical thresholds, geometry, aperture, measurement cadence, movement caps, and v11 receding trusted-face rules are inherited from the immutable v9 policy chain.
No comparison metric from the invalid v9 candidate was inspected or used to alter a threshold.

The quantized trusted-balance disposition performs no movement and applies only when a single approaching breached face and its opposite remain outside relaxation and every admitted approaching-direction parent-cell shift fails to strictly improve the weaker axis clearance.

Any legal shift that strictly improves the weaker clearance retains the existing relocation path; any current relaxation-zone entry remains unrecoverable, and ambiguity, topology, parent containment, and finite-evidence checks remain fail-closed.
A pass remains a bounded same-equation fixed-aperture comparison and does not enable public moving_nest selection or broaden supported physics/backend combinations.
